about_the_game:
Foresight of the Forgotten

Foresight of the Forgotten (FotF) is a strategic puzzle game where you plan up to ten actions in advance to guide your adventuring party through monsters, traps, and corrupted landscapes. Each level is a handcrafted challenge that demands logic, planning, and careful use of your party’s unique abilities.

Study the level to anticipate enemies and hazards

Rearrange the adventurers’ skills to build a vision sequence

Execute the vision and see it unfold

Features

  • 150 handcrafted puzzles with no filler and no randomness, designed for pure logic and planning

  • 5 story chapters, each highlighting a different adventurer’s journey

  • 6 unique characters, each with up to 4 specialized skills to combine in your visions

  • 40 enemy types and 30 hazards, including corrupted beasts, traps, and reimagined puzzle mechanics

  • An adventure narrative that unravels the Seer’s forgotten past while guiding the party through a world of memory and corruption

If you enjoy logic-heavy puzzle games that reward planning and foresight, this will challenge your mind. Step into a mysterious fantasy world and uncover the Seer’s forgotten past.

Core Mechanics

  • Sequencing Skills: Build visions by queuing up to 10 adventurer skills before executing.

  • Tile-Based Movement: Navigate an isometric grid filled with hazards and enemies.

  • Character Abilities: Each adventurer brings unique combat and movement skills for solving puzzles.

  • Obstacle Interactions: Reimagined classic puzzle mechanics like Sokoban blocks, pressure plates, and spike traps through character skills and strategy.

  • Foresight Mechanic: In the planning phase, the Seer observes enemy routes and the entire level layout, allowing you to anticipate dangers and commit to the best strategy.

  • Party Representation: The party moves as one; the active adventurer takes form when their skill is used.

Your goal is to craft the perfect vision to reach the fragment and survive each challenge.

Chapters

Chapter - I. A Pact Forged in the Deepwoods – The Seer and Aldric join Llen and Zyr to cleanse the forest of corruption.

Chapter - II. Lost Visions Illuminated – Transported to an enchanted realm, the party confronts ancient magic and new dangers.

Chapter - III. The Journey Before the Storm – Reaching civilization, the adventurers seek allies while facing intrigue and personal trials.

Chapter - IV. The Last Siege on Alvenwald – A desperate assault against the usurpers reveals the deeper truth behind the kingdom’s fall.

Chapter - V. The Prologue in Eternity – Time unravels as the Seer discovers their true identity and fate in the cycle of history.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent (supports Shader Model 3.0)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card

short_description: Guide an adventuring party as the Seer. Build visions by sequencing their skills, leading them through monsters and hazards in challenging puzzles that demand advanced planning.
